channel.title: QubiTO | Articles
channel.description: Articles by QubiTO, the quantum computing student team of Politecnico di Torino.

item.title: Quantum Cryptanalysis of CBC-MAC: Evaluating a Chosen-Plaintext Forgery on NISQ Hardware
item.description: We turn a known quantum attack on CBC-MAC, based on Simon's algorithm, into a pipeline that runs end to end, and test it on a simulator and on IQM's Sirius quantum computer. Today's hardware noise stops it beyond 2 bit blocks, but the weakness remains.

item.title: NIST 800-22 Statistical Tests Overview
item.description: A generalised guide for testing Random Number Generators (RNG)

item.title: Introduction to Classical Cryptography
item.description: This article explores the core principles of classical cryptography by analyzing the mechanics and brute-force vulnerabilities of Caesar and Substitution ciphers. It further examines the Vernam cipher (One-Time Pad) and discusses the importance of true randomness in achieving digital security.

item.title: Quantum Error Correction
item.description: Using techniques like repetition codes and the 9-qubit Shor code, quantum error correction enables reliable quantum computing by protecting qubits from bit-flip errors, phase-flip errors, and arbitrary errors.

item.title: Introduction to Qiskit
item.description: This short guide explains the basics of Qiskit, how to create a quantum circuit with custom gates and how to run an ideal simulation

item.title: Superconducting qubits
item.description: Introduction about the physics of superconductivity, the construction of a transmon qubit and the manipulation of information in a superconducting quantum computer
